name: Noetix Robotics
summary:
Noetix Robotics (Songyan Dynamics) develops humanoid robots with a focus on motion, accessible interaction and consumer-facing use. Its public product and demonstration activity includes compact humanoids and bionic robot heads, connecting physical movement with expressive human–robot communication.

The company's current materials emphasize making robots available beyond specialized laboratories, including public demonstrations and consumer-oriented deliveries. Its broader development work covers robot bodies, motion-control technology and interaction, with products intended to support entertainment, experimentation and other everyday use cases. The combination of moving humanoid platforms and expressive hardware reflects an interest in both physical capability and approachable robot experiences.
